chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 494: Ji Ning's Heartforce Shreds the Invincible Tortoise-Serpent Formation
chapter_meta_description: The Seamless Gate deploys the legendary Tortoise-Serpent Formation. But when Ji Ning arrives, a single strike from his Starseizing Hand proves that some swords are balanced on the scale of an Empyrean God.
og_title: Ji Ning Breaks the Invincible Formation
og_description: Watch as Ji Ning casually unleashes a god-slaying attack that shatters the ultimate Seamless Gate defense, proving his power has reached new heights.
twitter_title: Ji Ning’s Sword-Finger Erases Six Immortals
twitter_description: He tore through a formation meant to be 'invincible' with one strike. Ji Ning's Heartforce + Sword Force combo is a thing of terrifying beauty.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary defensive-offensive formation derived from Xuanwu Emperor's innate ability; combines the impenetrable defense of the Bixia Turtle with the deadly, space-devouring attacks of an azure serpent.

A primordial powerhouse from the ancient Pangu World, now one of the highest authorities in the Three Realms; his innate ability to 'Swallow the Heavens' is mimicked by the Tortoise-Serpent Formation.
The Tonghe Immortal's ultimate technique, a Sword Realm that fuses the Grand Dao of the Grand Polarity with the mysteries of the Five Elements, compressing into a domain of absolute slaughter.
A metaphysical power derived from the cultivator's Dao-heart; the third stage provides a massive, but finite, boost to attack power, representing immense willpower and cultivation.
A power that naturally manifests at a Sword Immortal's blade when they fully master the Grand Dao of the Sword and seek its deeper essence.
Ji Ning's movement-type divine ability, granting him explosive, unmatched speed on the battlefield.

The eternally dark, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the broader Chaosverse; it is featureless, devoid of Dao resonance, and forces cultivators to rely solely on physical arts and Heartforce for survival.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't the formation stop Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The formation was designed to be invincible below the Empyrean God/True Immortal level. Ji Ning's attack, boosted by Heartforce and Sword Force, actually reached that threshold, bypassing its defense ceiling.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does consuming one-fifteenth of Heartforce mean?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It means Ji Ning can only launch about fifteen attacks of this exact, god-tier power before his Heartforce runs out, making each strike a significant, strategic decision rather than a spammable ability.
No, he was trapped and severely battered by the serpent's attacks, but Ji Ning's intervention shattered the formation before he could be killed.
